Notes
  - The 0.186 npm package no longer ships pre-minified builds, so the readable
    ES module builds are vendored as-is. GitHub Pages serves them gzip-compressed.
  - three.module.js imports './three.core.js' relatively; no import map is used.
  - No addons (examples/jsm) are vendored. The workshop implements its own
    pointer-lock look controls, geometry merging and environment map.
  - Used only by /workshop/. The portfolio homepage never loads these files.
